scene.ofreeRecent: a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — seated on a chair; a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; an indoor roller-skating rink during a quiet afternoon — celebrating a cautious first glide by offering a small wave and laughing softly at her own nervous confidence; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — chest-deep in the water; a Guan Yu temple — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small private sleeper-train cabin at dawn — savoring the first teaspoon of honey in a warm breakfast while the train passes misty fields; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — sitting on the ground; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a Peking opera dressing room — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — perched on a ledge or edge; a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — holds a cup at chest height; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — standing; a city station platform or the inside of a commuter train — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw
